title: POV: You Went Flat Before Retail Sales… Then This Happened
description: POV: You finally listened. You went flat before the Retail Sales data drop — and watched everyone else get wrecked. This is what smart money traders do differently. R2F Trading breaks down the ICT way to trade high-impact news in 2026. Follow for daily setups.
script: POV: You're staring at the chart. Retail Sales drops in 20 minutes. Everyone's taking trades. You close yours. The group chat is firing. 'Long DXY.' 'Short it.' 'Easy money.' Your finger hovers over the button. Data drops. Dollar spikes 40 pips. Then — it reverses. Hard. Stop losses everywhere. That spike? It was a liquidity sweep. Smart money needed those stops to fill their orders. Then price dropped into the fair value gap. The real move started. You caught it clean. The lazier I got before news — the better my results. Patience IS the edge. 73% of retail traders lose on news candles. Follow R2F Trading. We post real ICT setups every day — including next week's Retail Sales breakdown.
